Celeste is there for the numbers she has that don’t scale off of something (ie arithmetica and phoenix trigger.) You can do whatever you want with her WoD or covs. I sometimes use DR sets, but I’ve also used keyflare when her weakness was important (and thus something I had to play anyway.)
I’ve even used damage amp, since it’s technically a team stat.

Vortice expects her team to: 
- Either fuel her aliemus or preferably multicast her 3-cost 
- Be able to spam exalts to trigger her pursuit 
- Be able to stack a considerable amount of tentacle damage, whether by stacking it directly or through strength 
- Not use too much arithmetica or generate more of it, since her cards are expensive 

She fits well with GMurphy, except GMurphy doesn't necessarily want her, since she isn't a Lemurian
Thais obviously works well, to no one's surprise 
Casiah, Pickman and Hameln work as alternative ways of multicasting her 3-cost 
Tulu, OE Corposant and Sanga's posse are the best options you have for generating tentacles for her outside of GMurphy
